summary: The filing is a Form 6-K disclosing an update to an existing at-the-market (ATM) equity offering facility. EZGO Technologies Ltd. reported that as of May 14, 2026, it had issued 325 million ordinary shares under the Sales Agreement with AC Sunshine Securities LLC, raising ~$24.9M gross proceeds (~$21.8M net after 3% commissions). The company has ~$75.1M remaining capacity under the $100M facility. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes, including R&D and US subsidiary expansion. This is a routine capital-raising update, not a special situation event.
